Fold suppresses inclusive cutoff membership/witnesses even on empty same-day replay; preserves post-cutoff same-brand/day evidence after ring eviction; removes orphan timestamps without creating IDs. legacy_semantics: A legacy ID without a timestamp remains unknown when no active tombstone exists; old/absent/wrong-brand/wrong-day ring evidence never becomes a trusted latest timestamp. Only positive same-brand/day ring evidence after an active cutoff rescues membership and records its witness. Such rescue always sets the brand's incomplete flag because the ring may omit later legacy history. The flag persists across further cutoffs and reruns until forward UTC-day rollover clears IDs, witnesses and uncertainty together.
